# Major Arcana - Tarot Cards (Stars in a Box)

- Source: "Major Arcana - Tarot Cards" by **Stars in a Box**: https://stars-in-a-box.itch.io
  (Instagram @stars.in.a.box, Twitter @stars_in_a_box).
- Used: the card back (`cardBack_1x.png`, copied here from `cards/_cardBack/_cardBack_1x.png`).
- **Licence (from the pack's readme):** credit the artist in the project with a link to their itch.io page or their
  Instagram handle; **do not redistribute or resell** the art as your own; do not use it for AI / NFT projects or AI
  training. So keep this folder out of any public repository.
- Credit line for the game's credits: "Card back: Major Arcana Tarot Cards by Stars in a Box (stars-in-a-box.itch.io)".

`Tools/CardForge/card_back.py` refits it to the game's 48 x 64 card (the middle rows and the orb dropped, the two centre
columns repeated) with a gold ring and a tintable gem in the centre, into `Resources/Cards/CardBack.png` and
`CardBackGem.png`.
